summary: Build practical flexible compensation and benefits skills with salary modelling, pay equity, dashboards, and implementation planning. Enrol today.
lede: Compensation and benefits training helps HR and reward professionals design transparent pay and benefits choices using workforce and cost evidence. Participants learn to build job-based salary ranges, model benefits costs, review pay equity, and create reward dashboards and approval controls, then develop employee communications and an implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: Flexible compensation and benefits programs training suits professionals who influence pay, benefits, workforce planning, employee experience, or reward governance. It supports intermediate practitioners who already work with HR data or reward processes and need a more structured design and reporting approach.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of compensation, benefits administration, HR operations, payroll, workforce planning, or people analytics is recommended. You should be comfortable reviewing spreadsheets and interpreting basic workforce metrics. No programming is required. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted compensation analysis are covered at conceptual awareness and operational application levels, not technical engineering depth.
